verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Azure publishes a free account offer and a free-services page (azure-docs-16/17/24/25) plus a pricing calculator, but the evidence pack contains no detail on the actual free-tier limits, credit amounts, or expiry terms — just page titles/URLs. Missing for 10: documented $-amount of startup credit, duration/expiry of free trial, specific service quotas for 'always free' tier, and any independent corroboration that these terms are clear/accurate.
